description: Dried leaf, faintly minty, that removes you from the category of "person" for about a minute.

effects.comeon_message: You hold the smoke. Nothing. Nothing. Then the room takes a step to the left.

events.text: [trip]The room hinges open along a line that was always there.[/trip]
[trip]You are being turned. You have edges now, and someone is checking them.[/trip]
[trip]You have been here before, in this exact wrongness, and you had forgotten completely.[/trip]
[trip]Something enormous is politely folding you back into the shape of a person.[/trip]
[trip]You come back all at once, with the taste of mint and the certainty that you have just been somewhere.[/trip]

effects.onset_message: You are not a person any more. You are a surface, or an edge, or a length of something, and you are being turned.

overdose.message: You take far too much and spend a bad four minutes convinced you are a garden fence. It passes. It always passes.

effects.take_line: You pack a bowl of {name} and burn it hot.

name: salvia
